claims: Michael B. Jordan won his first Academy Award for Best Actor at the 98th Oscars on March 15, 2026.
Michael B. Jordan won for his dual role as twins Smoke and Stack in the film Sinners.
Sinners was directed by Ryan Coogler.
Michael B. Jordan's Oscar win at the 98th Oscars is his first Oscar win.
Michael B. Jordan's Oscar nomination at the 98th Oscars is his first Oscar nomination.
Michael B. Jordan won at the Actor Awards.
Michael B. Jordan played twin brothers Elijah “Smoke” and Elias “Stack” Moore in Sinners.
Michael B. Jordan is the sixth Black actor to win the Oscar for a leading role, joining Sidney Poitier, Denzel Washington, Jamie Foxx, Forest Whitaker, and Will Smith.
Sinners had four total wins at the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners' wins at the 2026 Oscars include Michael B. Jordan's Best Actor award.
In his acceptance speech, Michael B. Jordan paid tribute to the Black actors who paved his path.
In his acceptance speech, Michael B. Jordan thanked his collaborators, including Ryan Coogler.
In his acceptance speech, Michael B. Jordan called Ryan Coogler his "sensei".
